verdict.rationale: An OpenAPI spec is confirmed to exist and is machine-readable (openapi.json returns valid schema), which could underpin an interactive reference, but there is no evidence of an actual interactive docs UI (e.g., Swagger/Redoc) or runnable code examples being presented to users. missing for 10: a documented interactive API explorer, runnable/try-it-out examples, and any user-facing confirmation of this experience.
